description: What a triage run came to: the diagnosis, and where it was written. A submission that carries a question lands nothing and has the action none.

issue.description: The issue the diagnosis was written to or would have been, or null when nothing was.

host.description: The host of the forge, or an empty string when the run did not record one.

action.description: replaced_body: the body of the issue is the diagnosis around the original report. commented: the body would have been too long for the forge, so the diagnosis is a comment and the body is as it was. created_issue: a new issue holds the diagnosis. planned: a dry run, which sent nothing. none: nothing was written, for --land none or a question.

diagnosis.description: The diagnosis as it was stored: its paths cleaned and path:N split into a path and a line.

rejected_path_calls.description: How many refused submit calls of the run cited a path that is no file of the repository. Reported, and never a reason to land or not.

rejected_submissions.description: How many submit calls of the run were refused.

labels.description: The labels that were added, exact duplicates collapsed in the order they were given.

original_report_sha256.description: The hex SHA-256 of the person's original report, which the body of the issue keeps byte for byte.
